primary_task: Review the current branch's diff against the default branch for bugs and security vulnerabilities and report findings without changing code.

requirements.name: git
requirements.evidence: 1. Get the FULL diff: `git diff $(gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq '.defaultBranchRef.name')...HEAD`
requirements.basis: tools.bash: "build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh"

requirements.name: gh
requirements.basis: description: "The user's GitHub account is usable through the github connector and through the gh CLI via the proxy."

requirements.name: read (changed files)
requirements.evidence: 2. If output is truncated, read each changed file individually until you have seen every changed line
requirements.basis: tools.read: "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)"

notes: gh repo view assumes the repository's remote is on GitHub; if it is hosted elsewhere the command fails, but the default branch could be read with git alone (the document does not say so). Assumed GitHub remote, which the runtime supports.
